name: A 404 on `/models` is disambiguated, not assumed
prose: a catalog-less server and a wrong base URL both answer 404 there, and assuming the benign reading meant TEST reported success on a URL that could never work, sending the user to check an API key that was fine. The chat route is probed directly: 400/422/200 proves it exists, 401/403 proves it exists and refused the key, 404/405 means this is not the API.
invariant: A 404 on /models is disambiguated by probing the chat route: 400/422/200 proves it exists, 401/403 proves it refused the key, 404/405 means this is not the API.
